name: template-composition
body: Slide templates declare named sections, the section templates each accepts, and repeat limits (min/max, e.g. columns 2–4). A section template's `template.yaml` may declare `sections:` with exactly the schema slides use, so a section can hold sections of its own and composition nests. Nesting depth is bounded by the content syntax — heading depth is nesting depth — so no template composition chain may exceed six heading levels (`#`…`######`); this is checked at load, not configured (requirements.constraint.section-depth-limit). Reference cycles are rejected at load with the chain in the error (requirements.constraint.section-cycle-error-chain): a reference is a declared `sections:` acceptance or a `section` helper call in a layout (section-helper-load-checks), so two section templates whose layouts invoke each other through the helper are a cycle the same way a declared chain is. The depth bound counts heading-level composition; a helper call is a reference for cycle rejection but is not a heading, so it does not by itself extend the six-heading-level chain. Sections accept only section templates (those under `templates/sections/`), never slide templates (those under `templates/slides/`; requirements.constraint.template-registry-integrity).
